nodes.name: ReliefWeb disasters
nodes.notes: BLOCKED until an appname is registered. Verified live on 2026-07-20: an unregistered appname returns HTTP 403 AccessDeniedHttpException, not a rate-limit — the project plan's assumption that any appname string works is wrong. Register at https://apidoc.reliefweb.int/parameters#appname, then set RELIEFWEB_APPNAME. Still free, still no API key.
